description: The Windows template build inputs for a module that provisions from one.
_note: The windows block describes how the template is BUILT (image, unattend, drivers). update-service.sh reconciles the template, not the consuming guest.

windows.description: Windows-specific configuration options for Windows Server clone VMs.

enableRDP.description: Enable Remote Desktop Protocol. SSH over OpenSSH is always the primary access method.

windows.changeNote: The template build description. Changing it affects guests provisioned AFTERWARDS; an already-installed guest is not rebuilt, which is why this is not 'recreate' — nothing about the existing guest is claimed by it.
